result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it impossible for people to deceive themselves into believing that other people’s suffering is acceptable.

Not by forcing empathy — that can’t be forced. But by removing the quiet mental loopholes we use to look away: the idea that some lives matter less, that cruelty is justified by tradition, that comfort is worth another’s pain. If every person had to face the full, felt weight of the consequences of their choices, the world would become far kinder — not because people would be better, but because they could no longer pretend to be.
